headline: Iran Claims Seven Ships Hit in Persian Gulf as Oil Prices Surge
summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy claimed that seven vessels, including oil tankers, were hit or struck mines in the Persian Gulf amid flared regional tensions, pushing oil prices higher.
why: Geopolitical conflicts in the Persian Gulf threaten vital global crude oil supply routes, directly influencing international energy prices.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Threats to oil tanker transport through the Persian Gulf restrict supply and drive up crude prices.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Escalating geopolitical risk in key shipping lanes immediately lifts oil benchmarks.

why_moved: Reports of vessel attacks in a critical crude transit choke point raised fears of supply disruptions, triggering an immediate surge in oil futures.
